c1: The lantern flame flickers, the lychee branches sway gently, mist drifts over the river, the moored boat rocks slightly, moonlight shimmers on the water.
c4: The stream flows over the rocks, the pine branches sway, the old scholar slowly turns a page of his book, mist drifts across the mountains.
c10: The candle flame flickers, the woman slowly pours tea, the young man lifts his cup, the lychee leaves sway outside the window.
c16: The king slowly looks up at the sky, the bright star twinkles, the paper in his hand moves slightly in the breeze, the lamp light flickers.
c18: Incense smoke rises and curls, the visitors bow gently, the pine branches sway in the breeze.
